proposals.defect: Default model provider mapping is checked before the default model is verified to exist in the registry, so an unknown default model raises a raw KeyError instead of the public ConfigurationError.

Attempt timeout and fallback-shuffle validation are nested under the 'max_attempts is not None' branch, so they are skipped whenever the route-attempt limit is unset and invalid values pass through to execution.
